facts.fact: The COMESA IDEA half-year report (Jan-Jun 2026) states the Government national datacenter in Lilongwe is complete and that the Bomalathu platform has migrated to the National Data Centre, with a stop-gap expansion adding 115 TB of storage; it describes it as a Government data hosting facility, not one renting to outside customers.
The report describes the National Data Centre in Lilongwe as the Government of Malawi's own national datacenter, implemented under the state's Digital Malawi Acceleration Project.

The report states the Bomalathu Digital Services Platform has migrated to the National Data Centre in Lilongwe, which has a disaster recovery site in Blantyre, and that Government data hosting capacity was expanded by 115 TB.

systems.platform: government data centre, Lilongwe, with redundancy link to Blantyre data centre

note: Facts cover the Government national data centre; document does not say it rents to outside customers.
